mapper.select:
select bs.seq, bs.schedule_seq, bs.start_date, bs.end_date, bs.time, bs.account_seq, sch.schedule_type, tk.token, tk.platform from account_batch_schedule bs join account_schedule sch on sch.seq = bs.schedule_seq join firebase_token tk on tk.account_seq = bs.account_seq and tk.is_enabled
bs.is_enabled and sch.is_enabled and sch.alarm and bs.start_date = to_char(NOW() at time zone 'kst','YYYY-MM-DD') and bs.time = to_char(now() at time zone 'kst','HH24:MI:00') and sch.schedule_type in ('MEDICINE','ETC','HOSPITAL','MENTALITY')

select bs.seq, bs.schedule_seq, bs.start_date, bs.end_date, bs.time, bs.account_seq, sch.schedule_type, tk.token, tk.platform from account_batch_schedule bs join account_schedule sch on sch.seq = bs.schedule_seq join firebase_token tk on tk.account_seq = bs.account_seq and tk.is_enabled
bs.is_enabled and sch.is_enabled and sch.alarm and bs.start_date = to_char((NOW()+ interval '1 days' ) at time zone 'kst','YYYY-MM-DD' ) and bs.time = to_char(now() at time zone 'kst','HH24:MI:00') and sch.schedule_type in ('HOSPITAL')

select bs.seq, bs.schedule_seq, bs.start_date, bs.end_date, bs.time, bs.account_seq, sch.schedule_type, tk.token, tk.platform from account_batch_schedule bs join account_schedule sch on sch.seq = bs.schedule_seq join firebase_token tk on tk.account_seq = bs.account_seq and tk.is_enabled
bs.is_enabled and sch.is_enabled and sch.alarm and bs.start_date = to_char(NOW() at time zone 'kst','YYYY-MM-DD') and bs.time = to_char((NOW()+ interval '1 hours' ) at time zone 'kst','HH24:MI:00') and sch.schedule_type in ('HOSPITAL','MEDICINE')

select ts.account_seq ,ft.token ,ft.platform from track_service ts ,firebase_token ft
ts.is_enabled and ts.status = 'ACTIVE' and ts.account_seq = ft.account_seq and ft.is_enabled

select ts.account_seq ,ft.token ,ft.platform from track_service ts ,firebase_token ft
ts.is_enabled and ts.status = 'ACTIVE' and ts.account_seq = ft.account_seq and ft.is_enabled and to_char(cast(ts.created_at at time zone 'kst' AS timestamp) + (interval '1 days' * ts.days)+ (interval '-3 days'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') = to_char((NOW() ) at time zone 'kst','YYYY-MM-DD' )

select ts.account_seq ,ft.token ,ft.platform from track_service ts ,firebase_token ft
ts.is_enabled and ts.status = 'ACTIVE' and ts.account_seq = ft.account_seq and ft.is_enabled and to_char(cast(ts.created_at at time zone 'kst' AS timestamp) + (interval '1 days' * ts.days)+ (interval '-1 days'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') = to_char((NOW() ) at time zone 'kst','YYYY-MM-DD' )

select account_seq ,token ,platform ,progress from ( select ts1.account_seq ,ft1.token ,ft1.platform ,(select case when (a.tot_question_step_day_cnt::decimal = 0) then 0 else round(a.tot_answer_step_day_cnt::decimal / a.tot_question_step_day_cnt::decimal * 100) end as progress from ( select ac.seq , scd.cd as category_cd , (select count(*) from coaching_question_info cqi where cqi.progress_type_cd in ( 'A1','E01','K01') and cqi.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_question_step_day_cnt , (select count(distinct step_day_cd) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_answer_step_day_cnt , (select max(created_at) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as created_at from account ac left join track_service ts on ac.seq = ts.account_seq and ts.status = 'ACTIVE' , sys_code_det scd where 1=1 and scd.code = 'CATEGORY_CD' and scd.use_yn = 'Y' and ac.is_enabled and scd.cd in ('A','B','C','D') union all select ac.seq , scd.cd as category_cd , (select count(*) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_question_step_day_cnt , (select count(*) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.answer_choice = 'Y' and cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_answer_step_day_cnt , (select max(created_at) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as created_at from account ac left join track_service ts on ac.seq = ts.account_seq and ts.status = 'ACTIVE' , sys_code_det scd where 1=1 and scd.code = 'CATEGORY_CD' and scd.use_yn = 'Y' and ac.is_enabled and scd.cd = 'E' ) a where a.seq = ts1.account_seq and a.category_cd = #{categoryCd} ) as progress from track_service ts1 ,firebase_token ft1 where ts1.is_enabled and ts1.status = 'ACTIVE' and ts1.account_seq = ft1.account_seq and ft1.is_enabled ) aa where aa.progress > 0
select count(*) from public.account_cnt_statistics where year_month = to_char(now(),'yyyymm') and user_type_cd = #{userTypeCd}
select count(*) from public.account a where is_enabled = true and is_dropped = false and user_type_cd like #{userTypeCd}||'%'

select COALESCE( (select round(sum(userCnt)/NULLIF(count(*), 0)) from ( select to_char(a.login_at,'yyyymmdd'), count(distinct a.account_seq) as userCnt from public.account_login_history a ,public.account b where to_char(a.login_at,'yyyymm') = to_char(now(),'yyyymm') and a.account_seq = b.seq and b.user_type_cd like #{userTypeCd}||'%' group by to_char(a.login_at,'yyyymmdd') ) a), 0)

select count(distinct a.account_seq) from public.account_login_history a ,public.account b where to_char(a.login_at,'yyyymm') = to_char(now(),'yyyymm') and a.account_seq = b.seq and b.user_type_cd like #{userTypeCd}||'%'
mapper.insert: insert into public.account_cnt_statistics ( year_month , user_type_cd , value1 , value2 , value3 , value4 , created_at , updated_at ) values ( to_char(now(),'yyyymm') , case when #{userTypeCd} = '' then '99' else #{userTypeCd} end , case when to_char(now(),'yyyymmdd') = to_char(now(),'yyyymm')||'01' then #{userCnt} else null end , #{userCnt} , #{dayEnableCnt} , #{monthEnableCnt} , now() , now() )
